rule.name: SpringDataWriteWithoutTransaction
rule.message: Put @Transactional on this repository method, or on the repository interface. Spring Data opens a transaction only for the CRUD methods a repository inherits, so a declared @Modifying query or derived delete fails with TransactionRequiredException whenever its caller has no transaction.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $transactional := function($annotations) { exists($annotations[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.transaction.Transactional') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.transaction.Transactional')]) } return //ClassDeclaration[@Interface = true()][ExtendsList/ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.repository.Repository')]] [not($transactional(ModifierList/Annotation))] /ClassBody/MethodDeclaration[not(Block) and not(pmd-java:modifiers() = ('default', 'static'))] [not($transactional(ModifierList/Annotation))] [ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Modifying')] or (matches(@Name, '^(delete|remove)(\p{Lu}\w*?)?By') and not(@Name = ('deleteById', 'deleteAllById', 'deleteAllByIdInBatch')) and not(ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.NativeQuery')]) and ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1]/ExtendsList/ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository')])]
